title: Ad Operations Specialist
summary: Sets up, checks and runs online ad campaigns inside ad servers and programmatic buying tools, so that ads show to the right people on time and on budget. Sits between the sales or media-planning team and the tech platforms at publishers, ad tech firms and media agencies.
dailyDuties: Traffic orders, line items and creatives in the ad server
Set up programmatic deals with buyers and DSPs
Test ad tags and tracking pixels before launch
Check daily pacing and fix under-delivery
Send campaign delivery reports to sales and clients

skills.expectation: Traffic orders, line items and creatives in Google Ad Manager or CM360
Set up programmatic deals and campaigns in DV360 or other DSPs and SSPs
Implement and test ad tags, VAST tags and tracking pixels
Monitor pacing and fix under-delivery and discrepancies
Use verification tools to check viewability, brand safety and invalid traffic
Build delivery and performance reports in Excel
Coordinate launches with sales, clients and agencies
Understand header bidding and yield setups such as Prebid
Read HTML to debug creatives and tags
Use Google Analytics and tag managers

certifications.why: Covers display campaign setup and measurement basics
